column1: # Campaign 25 test evidence for the immutable bounded configured catalog.

column8: The configured catalog has no allocator lifecycle; source_order_and_stable_id_and_name_lookups_are_preserved covers only immutable source order and stable table identity while allocator retention remains open.
source_order_and_stable_id_and_name_lookups_are_preserved retains original display names while indexing case-insensitively; builder JSON original-name reconstruction remains open.
The artifact covers multiple stable case-insensitive configured table identities and duplicate rejection; builder store reconstruction and unloaded-table behavior remain open.
The immutable catalog requires complete startup descriptors and does not implement unloaded or lazily refilled tables.

Qualified and unqualified case-insensitive table lookup, source order, and stable ID lookup are covered; databases, policies, partitions, schema meta version, and broad InfoSchema behavior remain open.
The artifact constructs a bounded immutable catalog directly; mock InfoSchema table wrapping and allocator behavior remain open.
The configured catalog contains only explicit base tables; information_schema virtual table inventory remains open.
Temporary-table behavior is outside the immutable startup catalog boundary and remains open.
Placement bundle construction is not represented by the configured read catalog and remains open.
Configured tables are immutable and fully loaded at startup; refill context and cache behavior remain open.
Local temporary table overlays and session-scoped precedence remain open.
DDL metadata mutation and CREATE TABLE LIKE visibility remain open.
InfoSchema v2, lazy loading, and versioned caches remain open.
The catalog is immutable by design; applying schema diffs and DDL visibility remain open.
Stable immutable table IDs and duplicate rejection are covered; independent versioned InfoSchema mutation isolation remains open.
